PROBLEM (proven by a live failed-response.json at bench/results/stage7-door-smoke-attempt2/). The recorded hosted 2A prompt asks the model to return {"segments":[...],"selected_knowledge_ids":[],"item_facts":{...}}. In the hosted game ItemFactsProvider (storygame/runtime/item_facts.py around lines 600-635) lifts and removes item_facts before the reply reaches parse_turn_proposal. The door harness uses the plain provider, so raw_request() passes the whole reply, including a non-empty item_facts, to parse_turn_proposal. TurnProposal is a strict model (extra=forbid), so a perfectly good reply fails with 'provider response violates the turn contract'.

CHANGE. In door_transport.raw_request, after provider._request returns, if the normalized value (after the same envelope unwrapping parse_turn_proposal does: 'response' then 'content', and JSON-decoding a string) is a dict containing 'item_facts', split it off: parse the remainder with parse_turn_proposal, and keep the removed item_facts value on RawProposal as telemetry (e.g. field item_facts) and in the row/results artifacts. Keep the original normalized reply in the saved raw proposal unchanged. item_facts must never decide any verdict or be applied as world state. Any OTHER unknown key must still fail as before, and a reply without item_facts behaves exactly as now. Keep one request per trial, no retry, same spend accounting and the failed-response.json evidence. Add offline tests: reply with item_facts parses and keeps telemetry; reply with another unknown key still fails with the evidence file; reply with empty item_facts parses.

VERIFY: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q scripts/ringer/stage7/test_door_probe.py tests/test_bench.py tests/test_cloudflare_transport.py; ruff check --fix and ruff format on your files; then .venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/stage7/door_probe.py --n 12 --dry-run --out /tmp/door-dry-recheck2 && .venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/stage7/check_door_probe.py /tmp/door-dry-recheck2 12 --mode dry. Write scripts/ringer/stage7/door-fix2-notes.md (about 80 words, factual).
